span.p:
Part 1 · Autoencoders · §5–28
bottleneck z ≪ x → x̂ ≈ x · 🎯 linear AE + MSE = exactly the PCA subspace (Baldi–Hornik)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
Denoising — reconstruct clean from corrupted
noise lives in the discarded dims · §12–14

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
Sparse — force most units off · KL(Bernoulli(ρ) ‖ ρ̂)
§16–18 · modern: LLM interpretability, monosemantic features

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p: none of these are generative — the latent space has holes; a random z decodes to garbage · §19–20

div.style: color: rgb(237, 230, 215) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
VAE · encode a distribution q(z|x) = N(μ, σ²), not a point · §22
reparameterisation z = μ + σ⊙ε · ELBO = reconstruction − KL(q ‖ p) · reverse KL ⇒ mode-seeking ⇒ posterior collapse

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
VQ-VAE · snap z to the nearest codebook vector — discrete latents · §26–28
straight-through gradient · an image → a 32×32 grid of tokens ⇒ a Transformer over pixels (DALL·E, Jukebox)

div.style: color: rgb(237, 230, 215) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
Part 2 · Latent diffusion · §29–30
pixel-space diffusion is infeasible (512²×3, O(n²) attention) → run it in the VAE's latent space (64× fewer positions) — Stable Diffusion, Sora, Veo

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
Part 3 · Low-rank in Transformers · §31–35
the update ΔW has low intrinsic rank · LoRA: ΔW ≈ B·A, r ≪ min(d,k), B starts at 0 ⇒ ~10,000× fewer params, zero added latency · DoRA: decouple W = m·(V/‖V‖)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
Part 4 · Matryoshka embeddings · §36–39
fixed-size embeddings don't scale · train so every prefix z_{1:8} ⊂ z_{1:16} ⊂ … is valid · 256-dim MRL = 96.6% of full 1024-dim · beats post-hoc PCA (task-aware, learned during training)
